There are many types of filter circuits. They all operate on the
characteristics of reactive components to changing voltage levels.
The output of a filter will have a small amount of ripple voltage. In most cases the amount of ripple is so small that it is sufficient to call this smoothed DC or an almost constant DC level.
DEFINITION
RIPPLE VOLTAGE - Ripple voltage is produced by the charging and discharging of the capacitor.
Filter circuits consist of reactive components. The RC time constant of the capacitor and resistor eliminate the variations, called ripple, from the input.
The filter section changes the pulsating DC to smooth DC. .
The output of the rectifier is applied to the filter section.
Rectifier circuits contain diodes. One, two or four diodes are used to convert the AC into pulsating DC.
